title: Microsoft Foundry as Code
description: A technical briefing on managing Foundry agents as versioned code with unified azure.yaml, GitHub Actions, evaluation gates, and production feedback loops.
audience: developers, platform engineers, architects, and technical decision makers
learningObjectives: Explain why portal configuration alone is insufficient for reproducible, governed agent delivery.
Identify the project, model, connection, toolbox, agent, environment, and deployment controls in the unified azure.yaml model.
Design a GitHub Actions flow that deploys, smoke-tests, evaluates, compares, and promotes a Foundry agent candidate.
Define a versioned evaluation contract for a product use case using datasets, evaluators, baselines, and release policy.
Recognize production requirements for identity, environment separation, network controls, observability, rollback, and ownership.
